name: Shido Kaname
source:
Graduating at the top of his class from a super famous school in America, he is an excellent English teacher who possesses a prodigious wit. He's very popular amongst his students. Because his father is a diplomat, he's well-versed in a number of languages. At a glance he might seem like a good-natured teacher, but in truth, he loathes people who are stupid. He'll spontaneously confront the people he doesn't like, thoroughly persecuting them and finds pleasure in forcing them to surrender. His demeanor changes completely if his glasses are taken off.

[Taken from [URL=http://otome-jikan.net/2013/08/bad-medicine-infectious-teachers/]Otome Jikan[/URL].]
